# Blocked provider direction

## Destination

Verify the current runtime projection against the external provider checksum.

## Current state

The governing direction is recorded in
[the provider direction](../../docs/provider-direction.md). Verification can
resume when the external checksum is available.

## Blockers and dependencies

## Ready frontier

Wait for the checksum, then verify the current runtime projection.
